records."},{"step":7,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd/libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_uswid_firmware_parse","line":130,"var":"offset_tmp","code":"for (gsize offset_tmp = 0; offset_tmp < payloadsz;) {","note":"The parser iterates over the payload as a concatenation of coSWID images, advancing by each image's reported size."},{"step":8,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd/libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_uswid_firmware_parse","line":135,"var":"fw2","code":"fw2 = fu_bytes_new_offset(payload, offset_tmp, payloadsz - offset_tmp, error);","note":"A slice of the attacker-controlled payload is handed to the coSWID parser without additional structural validation."},{"step":9,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd/libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_uswid_firmware_parse","line":136,"var":"firmware_coswid","code":"if (!fu_firmware_parse(firmware_coswid, fw2, flags | FWUPD_INSTALL_FLAG_NO_SEARCH, error))","note":"The nested coSWID parser consumes the slice and may report a size that is inconsistent with the remaining bytes."},{"step":10,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd/libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_uswid_firmware_parse","line":145,"var":"offset_tmp","code":"offset_tmp += fu_firmware_get_size(firmware_coswid);","note":"The loop advances by the nested image size; if that size is malformed, later iterations can read past the intended payload boundary and trigger the heap-buffer-overflow read in the nested parser."}] 
JSON
